mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation ( room_id, user_id, reserve_date, start_time, end_time, status ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{userId}, #{reserveDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, '예약완료' )
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.room_id, a.user_id, a.reserve_date, a.start_time, a.end_time, b.username, a.status FROM reservation a JOIN users b ON a.user_id = b.id WHERE a.room_id = #{id} AND a.status = '예약완료' ORDER BY a.reserve_date, a.start_time
